description: The plot illustrates the Overall ROUGE-G Score for different models across varying numbers of training examples, comparing their performance under fully-supervised training and adapter training conditions. The x-axis represents the number of training examples, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 64 and tick labels at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis represents the Overall ROUGE-G Score, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 19.0 and tick labels at intervals of 2.0 from 11.0 to 19.0. The plot includes six lines representing different models and training methods: PELMS (red, solid) starts at around 15.0 and increases to 17.5; PELMS (5%) (red, dashed) starts at approximately 15.0 and reaches 16.5; Primera (green, solid) begins at about 17.0 and rises to 18.5; Primera (5%) (green, dashed) starts at roughly 16.0 and ends at 17.0; Pegasus-X (blue, solid) begins at around 11.0, dips to about 10.0, and then increases to 15.0; Pegasus-X (5%) (blue, dashed) starts at approximately 13.0, decreases to 12.0, and then rises to 14.5; Centrum (yellow, solid) begins at around 13.0 and increases to 15.0; Centrum (5%) (yellow, dashed) starts at approximately 13.0 and reaches 15.0. All lines generally increase across the x-axis, with Pegasus-X (blue, solid) and Pegasus-X (5%) (blue, dashed) exhibiting a dip at 16 training examples before rising again.
